title: Guelph colour analysis: the price today and the swatch book later

description: Read Guelph colour-analysis inclusions like a receipt: base fee, tax, take-home card and later swatch delivery. Check promotion terms and compare app tools.

sections.title: Separate regular pricing, promotions and delivered materials
sections.html:
For colour analysis in Guelph, check both the regular package and any temporary promotion. A discount can be useful, but it should not obscure when you receive your materials or whether the group price is per person. Compare the final amount and deliverables in writing.

Posy House Styling

The Guelph menu lists an individual session of about 1.5 hours at C$350 plus HST, using 16 categories. It describes a take-home card and a 45-colour swatch book delivered later. Group pricing is per person. The page advertises a launch discount, so confirm its current terms rather than assuming it remains available.

View the provider’s service information ↗

sections.title: Put the material-delivery date beside your event date
sections.html:
Ask when the swatch book arrives and what you can use immediately after the appointment. If bringing makeup or natural-hair photos, follow the provider’s preparation instructions. For a group, confirm that every guest receives the same references and enough individual discussion. Do not assume that a virtual option is bookable when the website still describes it as coming soon.

  • What is the final price after HST and any currently valid promotion?
  • When will my swatch book arrive, and what do I receive on the day?

sections.title: Keep group pricing separate from an individual offer
sections.html: Use the waiting period for any delivered materials to build a small outfit plan from existing clothes. Choose a neutral, two accents and one accessory, then note which combinations feel easy to wear. Stylist AI can help you explore those ideas on your phone. A live appointment adds physical comparison and conversation; choose it when that is the kind of support you want.

sections.title: Use the waiting period for a small wardrobe experiment
sections.html:
If the book arrives after the purchase you are planning, ask what the immediate card can help you do in the meantime. Also confirm delivery arrangements and whether a promotion changes any inclusions. Group pricing on the page is per person; it should not be mistaken for the total cost of bringing friends.

Stylist AI gives you a different digital starting point while you decide. Its selfie introduction leads to a seasonal palette, clothing combinations, lip and blush previews and hair exploration. A camera colour check can help you consider pieces you already own. Those tools do not replace the promised physical book or a consultant’s explanation, but they can help you narrow a colour question before committing to a larger purchase.
